findings.claim: All UP-1..24 expected affected arrays are alphabetical; a naive [...affected].sort() would pass the entire suite. Missing witness: affected-internal dependency edge against alphabetical order (a depends on z, both affected -> ["z","a"]).
findings.lead_cold_check: CONFIRMED — grep of ownership-update-plan.test.ts shows every expected affected array alphabetical (lines 60,68,77,85,93,102,119,128,142,194,258,276). UP-24 leaves z outside affected.
findings.disposition: Suite-coverage gap, not an implementation defect. Carried as observation for the Terra-1 fix-delta packet; suite additions would need a bounded follow-up, not a silent scope expansion.

findings.claim: No scenario with two required prerequisites on one artifact (a depends on b and z, both change -> ["b","z","a"]). A first-dependency-only regression would not be distinguished.
findings.lead_cold_check: CONFIRMED — fixtures have at most one required dependency per artifact (lines 18-44, 269-271).
findings.disposition: Same as CE1: recorded observation, not a blocker to the implementation verdict.

findings.claim: Newly-freed node overtaking an already-eligible one is covered by UP-10 ([base,flow,independent,skill]).

findings.disposition: Coverage adequate; reasoning accepted as corroborated.

findings.claim: Partial coverage of cycle variants: disconnected cycle / self-reference not exercised; UP-13 is refused by the reader (read.ts visiting set) before dependencyOrder's own ownership-cycle hold (update-plan.ts:98) runs.
